column1: # exec_rows.tsv — statement-side case-row table for gen_exec_row.py
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   name   : premise name (hSBrk/hSCont/…) → emits exec_<key>_row
#   key    : short case key used in the theorem/def names
#   shape  : row body shape — one of
#              leaf_reg  (register-only leaf: entry IS ExecEntry, exit ExecExit;
#                         apply <simD> directly with an ExecCaseGeom residual)
#   simD   : the landed *D lemma to marshal (rows/ExecCaseGeom.lean)
#   stmt   : the Stmt constructor pattern (the `s` index of the premise)
#   status : the produced Status pattern
#   ctor   : the ExecS constructor application (recursor derivation term)
#   k      : the statement-kind jump-table index
#   armpc  : the per-kind arm-entry PC constant (Vsa.Sim.<armpc>)
#   notes  : free text
# EMITTED (register-only leaves, sims fully unconditional modulo geometry):
#   hSBrk hSCont
# BLOCKED — NOT emitted (honest per-row reasons, see survey ledger step-6b):
#   hSRetNull : execRetNullSim carries an OPEN `hGlue` residual (arm setup +
#               beqz-TAKEN value_null bridge → SubExecReturnR) AND writes the
#               retslot [aRet,aRet+24) (a memFrame disjunct ExecLeafWiden does not
#               yet cover) — needs a retslot-aware widener + the glue closed.
#   hSVarNull : execVarDeclNullSim carries an OPEN `hGlue` residual (env_define is
#               NOT a landed Triple — M3 verified its prologue only) AND the exit
#               store CHANGES to `st.store.define env x null` (non-identity φ), so
#               ExecLeafWiden (identity-φ, unchanged store) does not apply.
#   hSExpr    : execExprSim takes a sub-EvalIH + an OPEN `hGlue`; the exit store is
#               st'.store (sub-eval mutated), non-identity φ — needs a rec-shaped
#               ExecExitD reland (armExec_rec territory), not a leaf widener.
#   hSRet     : as hSExpr plus the retslot write (rec + retslot).
